verdict.rationale: ByteAsk reads the codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests and sanitizers, and presents a reviewed diff (byteask-docs-1, byteask-docs-18). Its headless `exec` mode runs a task to completion for scripting and CI, with write access via `--sandbox workspace-write` (byteask-docs-4, byteask-docs-19, byteask-docs-20). That covers the implementation middle of the workflow, but nothing shows it ingesting a tracked issue or opening a pull request. Missing for 10: issue-tracker integration (reading a GitHub/Jira issue as input), automated branch/commit/push and pull-request creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end issue-to-PR flow.
